global_rules.rule: Every register*/set*/on* function returns IDisposable. Track it and dispose on cleanup.
Every provide* method returns ProviderResult<T> = T | undefined | null | Thenable<T | undefined | null>. Sync and async are both valid.
IRange and Position are 1-based (lineNumber and column both start at 1). LSP is 0-based — convert at the boundary.
register* takes a LanguageSelector (string | LanguageFilter | ReadonlyArray of either), NOT only a plain languageId string. The set* tokenizer functions take a plain languageId string.
model.getWordAtPosition(position) can return null — always null-check.
Check token.isCancellationRequested before and after expensive async work.
For completions return { suggestions: [] } rather than null.
